title: PHP & Server Setup Wizard
subtitle: Manage PHP versions, extensions, loaders and web-server settings in one place. Every change applies immediately at its step.

versions.name: PHP Versions
versions.desc: Add or remove a PHP version on the server

extensions.name: PHP Extensions & Loader
extensions.desc: Toggle a module, install PECL, ionCube

webserver.heading: Web Server
webserver.intro: This platform uses nginx with an isolated per-tenant PHP-FPM. There is no Apache compile or global Apache module selection as in cPanel/EasyApache; each domain runs in its own PHP-FPM pool and nginx vhost.
webserver.note: For a site's security headers, extra directives and Apache/nginx compatibility, use that domain's Apache & nginx screen.

summary.heading: Summary
summary.subtitle: The server's current PHP configuration. Every change takes effect at the step where it is applied.
summary.empty: No installed version found. Add one from the "PHP Versions" step.
summary.done: ✓ Configuration complete. A domain's PHP version and settings are chosen from that domain's PHP settings screen.
summary.emptyHint: Toggle on what you want from the "PHP Versions" and "PHP Extensions" steps, then install it all together here.
summary.bulkDone: ✓ Bulk install complete. The installed versions and extensions now show as active in their steps.
